name: @peartube/app
description: PearTube - P2P video streaming app (mobile + desktop)

scripts.android:prebuild: (cat android/local.properties 2>/dev/null > /tmp/local.properties.bak || true) && expo prebuild --platform android --clean && (if [ -s /tmp/local.properties.bak ]; then cat /tmp/local.properties.bak > android/local.properties; else echo "sdk.dir=${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}" > android/local.properties; fi)
scripts.android: npm run bundle:backend:ensure && npm run android:prebuild && expo run:android
scripts.ios: pkill -f metro || true; rm -rf /tmp/metro-* || true; npm run bundle:backend:ensure && npm run ios:prepare && npx pod-install && expo run:ios
scripts.bundle:backend: rm -f backend.bundle.js downloader-worker.bundle.js && bare-pack --target ios --target android --linked --out backend.bundle.js backend/index.mjs && bare-pack --target ios --target android --linked --out downloader-worker.bundle.js backend/downloader-worker.mjs
scripts.bundle:backend:main: rm -f backend.bundle.js && bare-pack --target ios --target android --linked --out backend.bundle.js backend/index.mjs
scripts.bundle:backend:worker: rm -f downloader-worker.bundle.js && bare-pack --target ios --target android --linked --out downloader-worker.bundle.js backend/downloader-worker.mjs
scripts.pear:merge: mkdir -p pear && rm -rf pear/_expo pear/assets "pear/(tabs)" pear/video && rm -f pear/*.html pear/metadata.json pear/favicon.ico && rsync -av --exclude='package.json' .pear-build/ pear/ && rm -rf .pear-build
scripts.pear:copy: cp pear-src/package.json pear-src/worker-client.js pear-src/index.js pear/ && mkdir -p pear/scripts && cp pear-src/scripts/build-release.js pear/scripts/
scripts.pear:install: cd pear && npm install && cd .. && node scripts/ensure-bare-mpv.js
scripts.pear:worker: mkdir -p pear/build/workers/core pear/build/workers && npx swc pear-src/workers/core/index.ts -o pear/build/workers/core/index.js && cp ../backend/src/transcode/hypercore-reader-worker.mjs pear/build/workers/hypercore-reader-worker.mjs
scripts.pear:build: npm run pear:export && npm run pear:merge && npm run pear:copy && npm run pear:install && npm run pear:worker && npm run pear:inject
scripts.pear:dev: npm run pear:build && cd pear && pear run --dev --store=$HOME/.peartube .
scripts.pear:stage: npm run pear:build && cd pear && pear stage .
scripts.pear:release: npm run pear:build && cd pear && pear release
scripts.build:ios: npm run bundle:backend:ensure && npm run ios:prepare && npx pod-install && expo run:ios
scripts.build:ios:device: npm run bundle:backend:ensure && npm run ios:prepare && npx pod-install && expo run:ios --device
scripts.build:android: npm run bundle:backend:ensure && npm run android:prebuild && expo run:android
scripts.build:android:apk: npm run bundle:backend:ensure && npm run android:prebuild && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:android:apk:arm64: npm run bundle:backend:ensure && npm run android:prebuild && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease -PtargetAbis=arm64-v8a -PreactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a
scripts.build:android:apk:armv7: npm run bundle:backend:ensure && npm run android:prebuild && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease -PtargetAbis=armeabi-v7a -PreactNativeArchitectures=armeabi-v7a
scripts.build:android:apk:x86_64: npm run bundle:backend:ensure && npm run android:prebuild && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease -PtargetAbis=x86_64 -PreactNativeArchitectures=x86_64
scripts.build:android:aab: npm run bundle:backend:ensure && npm run android:prebuild && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.build:eas:ios: npm run bundle:backend:ensure && eas build --platform ios --profile preview
scripts.build:eas:android: npm run bundle:backend:ensure && eas build --platform android --profile preview
scripts.build:eas:all: npm run bundle:backend:ensure && eas build --platform all --profile preview

author: PearTube
